text: As princes cannot help being hated by someone, they ought, in the first place, to avoid being hated by every one, and when they cannot compass this, they ought to endeavour with the utmost diligence to avoid the hatred of the most powerful.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XIX, That one should avoid being despised and hated
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
